PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/pages/catalog\(Marwan\)/collection.html" -UseBasicParsing; $content = $r.Content; if \($content -match "mkt-pl-rule"\) { "RULE: found" } else { "RULE: MISSING" }; if \($content -match "mkt-pl-wordmark"\) { "WORDMARK: found" } else { "WORDMARK: MISSING" }; if \($content -match "mkt-pl-dots"\) { "DOTS: found" } else { "DOTS: MISSING" }; if \($content -match "mkt-bg-ring|mkt-spin-arc|mkt-tick"\) { "OLD CIRCLE ELEMENTS: still present!" } else { "OLD CIRCLE: removed" })

PowerShell($pages = @\("http://localhost:3000/pages/catalog\(Marwan\)/collection.html", "http://localhost:3000/pages/product\(Marwan\)/product.html", "http://localhost:3000/pages/catalog\(Marwan\)/genres.html"\); foreach \($url in $pages\) { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing; $c = $r.Content; $name = \($url -split "/"\)[-1]; $status = $r.StatusCode; $rule = if \($c -match "mkt-pl-rule"\) {"Y"} else {"N"}; $dots = if \($c -match "mkt-pl-dots"\) {"Y"} else {"N"}; $old = if \($c -match "mkt-bg-ring|mkt-spin-arc"\) {"YES - BAD"} else {"clean"}; $black = if \($c -match '#0d0d0d'\) {"Y"} else {"N"}; Write-Output "$name | $status | rule=$rule dots=$dots old-ring=$old black-logo=$black" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/preloader.css" -UseBasicParsing; $c = $r.Content; $status = $r.StatusCode; if \($c -match "mkt-pl-rule"\) {"CSS rule: Y"} else {"CSS rule: MISSING"}; if \($c -match "mkt-dot-beat"\) {"CSS dot-beat: Y"} else {"CSS dot-beat: MISSING"}; if \($c -match "mkt-word-in"\) {"CSS wordmark: Y"} else {"CSS wordmark: MISSING"}; if \($c -match "mkt-spin|mkt-bg-ring|mkt-tick"\) {"OLD CSS still there: BAD"} else {"OLD CSS: removed"}; "Status: $status")
